subject: Flower
text: Take the red flower in the road for good luck and move forward to the celery forest.

evidence.quote:
Take the red flower in the road for good luck and move forward to the celery
forest.

subject: Percy
text: The baby persimmon sitting on the path is in need of water.

evidence.quote:
The baby persimmon sitting on the path is in need of water, so you'll
need to find him some.

subject: Water
text: Move to Lake Quench and take some water from the lake.

evidence.quote:
Move to Lake Quench and take some water, then go back to the celery
forest and give water to the persimmon.

subject: Percy
text: Give water to the persimmon and talk to him to have him join you on your quest.

evidence.quote:
give water to the persimmon. Now talk to the persimmon and he'll
join you on your quest. Select the LOOK command to exit the close-up of Percy.

subject: Prince Lettuce
text: Check the bush near the fence to discover Prince Lettuce, and revive the prince with water in order to speak to him.

evidence.quote:
Check the bush near the fence, then move there to discover
Prince Lettuce. You need to revive the prince with water in order to speak to
him.

subject: Pass
text: Give water to the dried up melons and talk to the melons to receive a gate pass.

evidence.quote:
give water to the dried up melons.
Talk to the melons and you'll receive a gate pass.

subject: Gold
text: Look at Lake Quench to discover a nest in the tree, and check the nest to find a gold coin.

evidence.quote:
Return to Lake quench and look to
discover a nest in the tree. Check the nest to find a gold coin.

subject: Town Gate Guard
text: Give the flower to the statue, use the Percy command for a hint, and sneak past the sleeping guard into town.

evidence.quote:
give the flower to the statue. Use the Percy command
to get a helpful hint about the gate guard. Return to the gate now and sneak
past the sleeping guard into the town.

subject: Garlic Wanderer
text: Take a look around at Orange Park and speak with the garlic to learn about an old scholar who lives on the mountain.

evidence.quote:
Take a look around at Orange Park. Speak with the garlic to learn about an
old scholar who lives on the mountain.

subject: Coin
text: Hit the fountain a few times until you get a coin, then be sure to take it with you.

evidence.quote:
Hit the fountain a few times
until you get a coin, then be sure to take it with you.

subject: Coin
text: If you ever see Octoberry go by on Main Street, be sure to check the street for coins.

evidence.quote:
Return to Orange Park, then go to Main Street. If you
ever see Octoberry go by here, be sure to check the street for coins.

subject: Coffee
text: Go to the coffee shop and buy a cup with the coin you got from the fountain.

evidence.quote:
Next go to the coffee shop and buy a cup with the
coin you got from the fountain.

subject: Letter
text: Speak with Mr. Pear at the antique shop to receive a letter to deliver to Miss Peachy at the deli for a sandwich.

evidence.quote:
receive a letter, which you should deliver to Miss Peachy at the
deli. As a reward, she'll give you a sandwich.

subject: Donut
text: Enter the cabaret, move to the restroom, and check the trash can a couple times to find a donut.

evidence.quote:
Move there and check the trash can a couple times to find a
donut; take it with you.

subject: Aspirin
text: At the pharmacy, talk to Mr. Fig a couple times to receive the aspirin.

evidence.quote:
At the pharmacy,
talk to Mr. Fig a couple times to receive the aspirin.

subject: Bookstore
text: Learn about the bookshop near the park, enter the shop, and look around and speak with the clerk.

evidence.quote:
learn about
the bookshop near the park. Enter the shop, look around and speak with the
clerk.

subject: Key
text: Hit the register and take the coin from inside, then check the counter and take the key you find there.

evidence.quote:
hit the register and take
the coin from inside. Now check the counter and take the key you find there.

subject: Farmies
text: Try to leave the bookshop and you will be captured by the farmies.

evidence.quote: Try to leave the bookshop and you'll be captured by the farmies.

subject: File
text: Hit Potato then talk to him to receive a file in the jail cell.

evidence.quote: Hit Potato then talk to him to receive a file.

subject: Interrogation Room
text: Use the file and you will be taken to the interrogation room to meet Lt. Pepper.

evidence.quote:
Use the file and you'll be taken to the interrogation room. Talk to Lt. Pepper
a few times until he discovers your file

subject: Torture Room Door
text: Use the hit command twice on the door, hit it once more to discover a keyhole, and use the key to escape.

evidence.quote:
Use the hit command twice on the door; Lt. Pepper will leave. Hit the door
once more and check it to discover a keyhole. Use the key from your inventory
on the keyhole to make your escape.

subject: Police Station Alarm
text: You can hit the alarm on the wall to set it off outside the jail cell.

evidence.quote:
You can hit the alarm on the wall to set it off but you'll eventually be re-
captured and taken back to the torture room.

subject: Rope
text: To the right is a storage room, in which you can find rope and a few other items.

evidence.quote:
To the right again is a storage room, in which you can find
rope and a few other items.

subject: Lantern
text: Take the lantern from inside the storage room, then use the lantern to disguise yourself and leave the station yard.

evidence.quote:
Take the lantern from inside, then exit the storage room and
exit the police station. Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the
police station yard.

subject: Police Station
text: Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the police station yard to escape and complete Chapter 3.

evidence.quote:
Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the
police station yard.

subject: Mole
text: Check the 3rd hole twice to find the mole hole, use the umbrella to get the mole out, and give him water for info.

evidence.quote:
check the 3rd hole twice to find
the mole hole. Use the umbrella to get the mole to come out. Talk to the mole
then give him some water. Talk to him some more and you'll receive info about
Saladron, plus the left half of some instructions.

subject: Water Wings
text: Give Mr. Leek his umbrella and you will receive a pair of water wings to cross the stream safely.

evidence.quote:
Give him his umbrella and you'll receive a pair of water wings. Use
the wings at the stream and you'll be able to cross safely.

subject: Stream Crossing
text: Use the wings at the stream and you will be able to cross safely.

evidence.quote:
Use
the wings at the stream and you'll be able to cross safely.

subject: Farmie
text: The farmie will always look down, so press down on the control pad.

evidence.quote:
The farmie will always
look down, so press down on the control pad.

subject: Parsley Forest
text: Collect the compass, tin can, shovel and gold found in the maze as you make your way to Saladron's lair.

evidence.quote:
Collect the
compass, tin can, shovel and gold found in the maze as you make your way to
Saladron's lair.

subject: Saladron
text: Use the tin can on the tree to summon Saladron and always select scissors, or left, to win three times.

evidence.quote:
use the tin can on the tree to summon Saladron.
Battle the beast the same way you did the farmie, but this time you'll have to
win three times to vanquish the enemy. Remember the tip you discovered at the
shrine earlier--always select scissors, or left.

subject: Medal
text: Use the shovel to dig up the mound until you find the medal, check the medal, and take it with you.

evidence.quote:
Use the shovel to dig up the
mound until you find the medal. Check the medal then take it with you.

subject: Grape Juice
text: Find Mr. Leek outside, talk to him to end the chapter; if you did not buy grape juice earlier, he will give you some.

evidence.quote:
find Mr. Leek outside. Talk to him to end the chapter; if
you didn't buy grape juice earlier, he'll give you some.

subject: Crest
text: Have a short meeting with the leader of the resistance, General Cantaloupe, and receive the resistance crest.

evidence.quote:
you'll have a short meeting with the leader of the resistance, General
Cantaloupe, and receive the resistance crest.

subject: Clover Juice
text: Talk to Grapy the guard and give him your grape juice to get clover juice.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Grapy the guard and give
him your grape juice.

subject: Nut Bomb
text: Go back to the arms room, which Grapy was guarding, have a look inside, and take a nut bomb.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the arms room, which Grapy was guarding, and have
a look inside. Take a nut bomb and head back to the meeting room.

subject: Resistance Base
text: Leave the base and move to the village to end the chapter.

evidence.quote: Leave the base and move to the village to end the chapter.

subject: Hudson Bee Statue
text: Use the wordbook at the park to decipher the message on the statue.

evidence.quote:
Use the wordbook at
the park to decipher the message on the statue.

subject: Bananda's Cave
text: Return to the cave with the lamp and enter Bananda's cave.

evidence.quote:
Now you should have the lamp, so return to the cave and
enter. Bananda's cave is a maze similar to the Parsley Forest.

subject: Bananda
text: You will run into Bananda near the entrance of the cave; use the nut bomb to destroy it.

evidence.quote:
You'll run
into Bananda near the entrance of the cave; use the nut bomb to destroy it.

subject: Battery
text: Talk to the chief to receive the battery that powers the Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote: talk to him to receive the battery that powers the Dice-O-Matic.

subject: Coins
text: Return to Bananda's cave and collect coins along the way to the Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote:
Return to Bananda's cave and find your way to the Dice-O-Matic. There's coins
to collect along the way.

subject: Dice-O-Matic
text: When you happen upon the Dice-O-Matic, use the medal on it, enter the cockpit, use the battery, and hit the red lever twice.

evidence.quote:
When you happen upon the Dice-O-Matic, use the medal on it and enter. In the
cockpit, check the vicinity and consult Percy; he'll find the slot for the
battery. Use the battery then hit the red lever twice to start up the machine.

subject: War Melon Army
text: Fight the huge enemy Dice-O-Matic and Minister Pumpkin in his Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote:
fight the huge enemy Dice-O-Matic. This
enemy will switch between rocks and scissors, then alternate between looking
right then left during the Look-Away phase of battle. Next you'll fight
Minister Pumpkin in his Dice-O-Matic

subject: Chameleon Grass
text: When you check the root of the giant tree you will discover strange grass to take with you.

evidence.quote:
when you check the root you'll discover strange grass. Take
the grass with you

subject: Chameleon Grass
text: Use the chameleon grass twice to turn into farmies and end the chapter.

evidence.quote:
Now use the chameleon grass twice to turn into farmies and
end the chapter.

subject: Squash
text: Talk to the wanderers, use the crest, and talk to squash to get info about Pea Street.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the
wanderers then use the crest. Talk to squash to get some info about Pea
Street.

subject: Key
text: Talk to Ron a couple times until you receive a key from him in the bar.

evidence.quote: Talk to Ron a couple times until you receive a key from him.

subject: Castle Secret Passage
text: Navigate the passage forward, right, left, forward, then use the shovel to dig away the wall and reveal the cave exit.

evidence.quote:
she'll tell you how to navigate the
passage: FORWARD, RIGHT, LEFT, FORWARD. Return to the passage and follow these
directions. Move forward again after the sequence and you'll hit a wall. Use
the shovel to dig away the wall and reveal the cave exit.

subject: Oil Pot and Chain
text: Take the oil pot and pine tar, and take the mirror and chain you find in the castle storage room.

evidence.quote:
take the oil pot and pine tar. Now check the vicinity
and use the look command. Take the mirror and chain you find.

subject: Percy
text: Use the water wings to save Percy, Percy will find an ornament in the pond, and take water from the pond.

evidence.quote:
Use the water wings to
save Percy; if he says you have too much stuff, dump the pine tar (you can't do
anything with it anyway). Percy will find an ornament in the pond. Take some
water from the pond

subject: Hallway Guard
text: Use the ornament to get the guard's attention, use the oil pot, and use the chain to tie up the guard.

evidence.quote:
Use
the ornament to get the guard's attention, then use the oil pot. Now use the
chain to tie up the guard.

subject: Caterpillar
text: Check Lettuce in the jail cell a couple times until you find a caterpillar and take it with you.

evidence.quote:
check Lettuce a couple
times until you find a caterpillar. Be sure to take it with you.

subject: Princess Tomato
text: Show the woman the crest, give her the chameleon grass, and talk to Princess Tomato.

evidence.quote:
show her
the crest. Talk to her until she tells you to get out. Move back, talk to her
again and immediately give her the chameleon grass. Talk to the princess

subject: Fancy Door Guard
text: Fight the door guard to get past him; he is easy to beat if you remember he always looks up during battle.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to fight the door guard to get
past him; he's easy to beat if you remember he always looks up during battle.

subject: Baby Monster
text: In order to solve the maze, you first need to make your way to the baby monster.

evidence.quote:
In order to solve the maze, you first need to make your way to the baby
monster.

subject: Mama Monster
text: The moma and papa monsters always look left during battle.

evidence.quote:
The moma
and papa monsters always look left during battle.

subject: Papa Monster
text: Find the three holes in order from 1 to 3, then go to where the papa monster lurks.

evidence.quote:
find the three holes in order from 1 to 3, then go to
where the papa monster lurks.

subject: Minister Pumpkin
text: To win against Minister Pumpkin, use the following moves: Paper, Paper, Rock, Scissors, Rock, Scissors, Scissors, Paper.

evidence.quote:
Minister
Pumpkin follows a pattern during battle, which repeats itself. To win, use
the following moves:

- Paper
- Paper
- Rock
- Scissors
- Rock
- Scissors
- Scissors
- Paper

subject: Princess Tomato
text: Talk to Princess Tomato, make your way to the garden, and move to the exit to escape.

evidence.quote:
talk to her
a couple times. Make your way to the garden and move to the exit.

subject: Junior Pumpkin
text: When Jr. Pumpkin challenges you to a fight, use the caterpillar on him to beat the game.

evidence.quote:
When Jr. Pumpkin challenges you
to a fight, you can choose to fight him but winning won't accomplish anything.
Instead, use the caterpillar on him. Congratulations, you've beat the game!
